note: Cross-repo contract for the managed-model map. The Cloud decides which models it MINTS a tmpx_ token for (infraweaver-ui src/features/billing/managed-models.ts: MANAGED_MODELS, findManagedModel, isUnservableManagedModel) and the EU gateway decides which Bedrock id each one RUNS as (infraweaver-proxy terraform/terraform.tfvars bedrock_model_map, resolved by src/bedrock.ts resolveBedrockModel). An entry on one side without the other is answered by the proxy's default model and metered at its rate, silently. Committed in BOTH repos; each side reads its own copy and byte-compares the sibling's when checked out.
